```artifact
@startuml
actor Patient
actor Doctor
actor Chemist
participant "Patient Management System" as PMS
participant "Consultation Request System" as CRS
participant "Appointment Scheduler" as AS
participant "Machine Learning Model" as ML
participant "Doctor Interface" as DI
participant "Chemist Interface" as CI
participant "Patient History File" as PHF
participant "Appointment File" as AF
participant "Prescription File" as PF
participant "Lab Request File" as LRF

== Test Case TC-001: Patient creates a Consultation Request (Offline) ==
Patient -> CRS: Create Consultation Request (Symptoms: Fever, Mode: Offline)
CRS -> PHF: Store Consultation Request
PHF -> CRS: Confirmation
CRS -> ML: Send Consultation Request for Prioritization
ML -> CRS: Return Priority (Critical)
CRS -> DI: Notify Doctor of New Consultation Request (Priority: Critical)

== Test Case TC-002: Patient creates a Consultation Request (Appointment) ==
Patient -> CRS: Create Consultation Request (Symptoms: Cough, Mode: Appointment, Date: Same Day)
CRS -> AS: Check Availability for Same Day
AS -> CRS: Availability (False)
CRS -> Patient: Notify Unavailability for Same Day
Patient -> CRS: Create Consultation Request (Symptoms: Cough, Mode: Appointment, Date: Next Day)
CRS -> AS: Check Availability for Next Day
AS -> CRS: Availability (True)
CRS -> AF: Create Appointment Entry
AF -> CRS: Confirmation
CRS -> PHF: Store Consultation Request
PHF -> CRS: Confirmation
CRS -> ML: Send Consultation Request for Prioritization
ML -> CRS: Return Priority (Medium)
CRS -> DI: Notify Doctor of New Consultation Request (Priority: Medium)

== Test Case TC-003: Batch Program for Appointment File Creation ==
AS -> AF: Purge Existing Appointment File
AF -> AS: Confirmation
AS -> CRS: Fetch Consultation Requests for Next 5 Days
CRS -> AS: Return Consultation Requests
AS -> AF: Create Appointment Entries for Next 5 Days
AF -> AS: Confirmation

== Test Case TC-004: Machine Learning Model Prioritizes Consultation Requests ==
ML -> CRS: Receive Consultation Requests
CRS -> ML: Send Consultation Requests
ML -> CRS: Return Prioritized Requests (Critical, Medium, Low)
CRS -> DI: Notify Doctor of New Consultation Requests (Priorities: Critical, Medium, Low)

== Test Case TC-005: Doctor Provides Diagnosis and Prescribes Medicines ==
Doctor -> DI: View Consultation Requests
DI -> Doctor: Display Consultation Requests (Priorities: Critical, Medium, Low)
Doctor -> DI: Provide Diagnosis and Prescribe Medicines
DI -> PF: Create Prescription Entry
PF -> DI: Confirmation
DI -> LRF: Create Lab Request Entry (if any)
LRF -> DI: Confirmation

== Test Case TC-006: Chemist Views and Updates Prescription Status ==
Chemist -> CI: View Open Prescriptions
CI -> PF: Fetch Open Prescriptions
PF -> CI: Return Open Prescriptions
Chemist -> CI: Update Prescription Status (Delivered)
CI -> PF: Update Prescription Status (Delivered)
PF -> CI: Confirmation

== Test Case TC-007: Retrieve Patient History File ==
Patient -> PMS: Request Patient History (Patient ID)
PMS -> PHF: Fetch Patient History (Patient ID)
PHF -> PMS: Return Patient History
PMS -> Patient: Display Patient History

== Test Case TC-008: Speciality-wise Consultations and Revenue ==
PMS -> PHF: Fetch Consultation Data (Speciality, Month/Quarter/Year)
PHF -> PMS: Return Consultation Data (Speciality, Month/Quarter/Year)
PMS -> PMS: Calculate Consultation Counts (Speciality, Month/Quarter/Year)
PMS -> PMS: Calculate Revenue Earned (Speciality, Month/Quarter/Year)
PMS -> Patient: Display Consultation Counts and Revenue (Speciality, Month/Quarter/Year)
@enduml
```
